exposure: maximum diameter of the gestational sac
thickness of the remaining muscle layer of the lower uterine segment
outcome: incidence of residual tissue after negative pressure aspiration
cohort: A total of 899 patients with endogenic cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy who underwent negative pressure suction treatment and follow-up.
finding: A predictive nomogram using age, BMI, intraoperative major hemorrhage, maximum gestational sac diameter, and remaining uterine muscle thickness was successfully developed and validated to predict residual tissue after negative pressure aspiration for endogenic cesarean scar ectopic pregnancy.
